description:
About the role
  
  
This role oversees safety, compliance, quality management, workforce health and discipline, and ESG initiatives within a construction organisation. The position requires strategic leadership across regulatory compliance, quality assurance systems, workforce safety culture, and sustainability practices, with responsibility for managing internal teams and coordinating with external stakeholders and authorities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Safety, Compliance & Governance
  
  
Oversee and ensure that outsourced Workplace Safety & Health (WSH) providers fulfil their responsibilities in accordance with MOM, BCA and applicable statutory requirements.
  
  
Develop, review and monitor the company's compliance frameworks, risk governance systems and internal control processes.
  
  
Audit and evaluate outsourced safety reports, site inspections, and recommendations to ensure effective compliance.
  
  
Oversee compliance with applicable ISO standards, bizSAFE, CONQUAS, Green and Gracious Builder Scheme (GGBS), and other relevant industry requirements.
  
  
Lead internal audits, compliance inspections and investigations, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are implemented effectively.
  
  
Provide strategic advice to management on regulatory updates, compliance risks and industry best practices.
  
  
Coordinate with relevant authorities and industry bodies, including MOM, BCA, SCAL and NEA, on compliance matters.
  
  
Oversee incident reporting, root cause analysis, and implementation of risk mitigation measures.
  
  
Develop and enforce company-wide policies covering compliance, quality, ESG and ethical practices.
  
  
Build, develop, train and manage the company's internal safety department and team members.
  
  
2. Quality Management
  
  
Establish, implement and maintain the company's Quality Management System (QMS) in alignment with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and other applicable management system standards.
  
  
Ensure project quality objectives are aligned with contractual, regulatory, and client requirements.
  
  
Lead quality audits, site inspections and document reviews to ensure compliance with established QMS procedures.
  
  
Possess strong knowledge of BCA CONQUAS standards, assessment criteria and relevant BCA quality assessment requirements.
  
  
Oversee CONQUAS assessment preparation, internal quality inspections, documentation, and coordination with project teams to achieve project quality targets.
  
  
Monitor workmanship quality, identify areas for improvement and implement corrective measures to improve BCA assessment outcomes.
  
  
Work closely with project teams to drive quality improvement initiatives and resolve non-conformities.
  
  
Monitor suppliers and subcontractors to ensure quality standards are maintained throughout the construction process.
  
  
Promote continuous improvement through training, mentoring and cross-departmental collaboration.
  
  
Prepare and present quality performance reports, assessment results and improvement recommendations to senior management.
  
  
3. Workforce Health, Safety & Discipline
  
  
Champion company-wide initiatives to promote a healthy, safe and disciplined workforce, with particular emphasis on construction workers and site personnel.
  
  
Work closely with the HR Department to develop, implement and monitor workforce health, safety, discipline and behavioural improvement programmes.
  
  
Initiate and lead awareness campaigns, training programmes and engagement activities that encourage healthy lifestyles, safe working practices and positive workplace behaviour.
  
  
Develop initiatives to strengthen workers' safety awareness, personal responsibility, compliance with site rules and workplace discipline.
  
  
Collaborate with HR and project teams to identify recurring safety violations, disciplinary concerns and workforce behavioural risks, and recommend preventive and corrective measures.
  
  
Promote workers' health and well-being through preventive health awareness, fatigue management, heat stress prevention and other relevant workplace health initiatives.
  
  
Support HR in developing consistent and fair workforce conduct policies, communication programmes and corrective action processes.
  
  
Establish measurable indicators to evaluate the effectiveness of workforce health, safety and discipline initiatives.
  
  
Foster a positive safety culture through regular communication, recognition programmes, worker engagement and continuous improvement.
  
  
4. ESG & Policy Governance
  
  
Drive, lead and implement the company's Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) initiatives in alignment with industry sustainability goals and applicable regulatory requirements.
  
  
Monitor and report ESG performance metrics, ensuring alignment with client expectations and relevant reporting frameworks.
  
  
Engage stakeholders to embed sustainable and responsible practices across operations, supply chains and projects.
  
  
Lead internal communication, training and awareness programmes to promote sustainability, accountability and good governance.
  
  
Develop, implement and maintain company-wide policies relating to ESG, ethical conduct and corporate governance.
  
  
Collaborate with HR and other departments to integrate employee well-being, workplace safety and responsible employment practices into the company's ESG objectives.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Workplace Safety & Health, Environmental Engineering, Quality Management, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  
  
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in safety, compliance and quality management within the construction industry.
  
  
Strong knowledge of Singapore's WSH Act, relevant BCA requirements, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and the bizSAFE framework.
  
  
Good knowledge of BCA CONQUAS assessment standards, workmanship quality requirements and assessment preparation processes.
  
  
Proven experience in managing audits, certifications, compliance reporting and quality improvement initiatives.
  
  
Experience in developing or implementing workforce safety, health, behavioural improvement or employee engagement programmes.
  
  
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with HR, project teams and external service providers.
  
  
Good analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence workplace culture and drive organisational improvements.
  
  
Added Advantage
  
  
Previous experience working with a Singapore construction main contractor.
  
  
Experience coordinating BCA CONQUAS assessments and construction quality improvement programmes.
  
  
Experience leading workforce safety campaigns, employee well-being initiatives or behavioural safety programmes.
  
  
Familiarity with ESG reporting, sustainability frameworks and construction industry certification schemes.
  
  
Possession of a recognised Environmental Control Officer (ECO) certificate or relevant ECO qualification.
  
  
BCA Green Mark-related professional certification or accreditation, together with knowledge of Green Mark assessment criteria, sustainable building practices and environmental performance requirements.

title: Research Fellow (Oceanography / Sediment Dynamics / Ocean Engineering / Environmental Engineering)
description:
The Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) is a University Research Institute at Nanyang Technological University Singapore that conducts fundamental research on earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, tsunamis, and climate change in and around Southeast Asia, towards safer and more sustainable societies. For more details, please view https://earthobservatory.sg/

The Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) invite applications for the position of Research Fellow.

The Research Fellow will join a new project awarded by the Public Utilities Board (PUB) and Coastal Protection and Flood Resilience Institute Singapore (CFI) collecting data from the Johor Strait to better protect Singapore’s coastline amidst climate change. This is an international, multi-institutional and trans-disciplinary program involving top researchers from the local and international community that aims to understand sediment budgets and source-to-sink relationships. Understanding the relationship between local climate drivers, coastal processes and sediment dynamics will allow for improved predictions of coastal change under the variety of climate scenarios in the coming decades.

The work will involve developing and applying hydrodynamic and sediment transport models, conducting field measurements, quantifying erosion and deposition processes, predicting sediment pathways and budgets, and integrating multidisciplinary environmental datasets. Active participation in research will be encouraged, and support for publication and meeting/conference presentations can be available.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop hydrodynamic and sediment transport models for fluvial-marine systems, including river channels, intertidal mangrove and mudflat areas and adjacent subtidal environments.
* Conduct and analyse field measurements of flow conditions, turbulence, seabed and water sedimentology and related environmental parameters in Singapore’s coastal and marine environments.
* Quantify relationships between hydrodynamic intensity and sediment erosion/flux/deposition patterns using field measurements and modelling data.
* Support the development of physics-based models to predict sediment source-to-sink pathways and spatial variations in sediment erosion and accretion rates and capacities (sediment budget) in fluvial to shallow marine environments.
* Integrate hydrodynamic/sediment transport modelling outputs with sedimentology, geochemistry, and other relevant datasets (eg satellite images) generated by the broader CFI project team.
* Prepare technical reports, peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and project deliverables.
* Maintain efficient data collection to ensure accuracy and completeness of data and preparation of the Data Management Plan for annual submission
Engage in the dissemination of the results of the research with the support of and under the supervision of the Principal Investigator  

**Job Requirements:**

* Possess a PhD in Oceanography, Sediment Dynamics, Ocean Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a closely related discipline in geosciences.
* Strong background in hydrodynamic and sediment transport modelling.
* Experience with fluvial, estuarine, mangrove, intertidal and shallow marine field measurements is highly desirable.
* Experience with numerical modelling tools such as Delft3D, SWAT, or equivalent hydrodynamic / sediment transport models will be advantageous.
* Experience with field instrumentation such as ADCPs, current meters, turbidity sensors, sediment traps, or related coastal-marine monitoring equipment will be advantageous.
* Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, or similar programming / data-analysis tools. Further ability to use AI/Machine Learning methodologies for data-analysis, predictions etc will be highly advantageous.
* Strong publication record and ability to work independently.
* A team player in a project setting, also with ability to work independently in a multi-cultural team environment
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills  

Interested applicants are invited to submit a full CV.

  

EOS seeks a diverse and inclusive workforce and is committed to equality of opportunity. We welcome applications from all and recruit on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status, family responsibilities, or disability.

  

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

description:
Guided by our vision to be the “Best Bank for a Better World”, DBS seeks to create long-term value for stakeholders in a sustainable way. We see sustainability as an active value driver that offers new opportunities, enhances resilience against sustainability-related risks and strengthens trust with our stakeholders.

  

**Functions of the CSO Team**

The Chief Sustainability Office (CSO) sets DBS’ Group-wide sustainability direction and governance agenda and coordinates delivery of its sustainability commitments with teams across the bank. It serves as a central team supporting senior management in integrating the Group’s strategic sustainability direction into the business.

The CSO works with senior management and key governance forums, including the Board Sustainability Committee, Group Sustainability Council and Group Climate Council, to align priorities and drive delivery against the Group’s sustainability scorecard. It leads or coordinates strategic sustainability initiatives and develops relevant policies, frameworks and guidance to support consistent implementation across the bank.

The CSO also brings an outside-in view of market, regulatory, and client trends, and translate these into clear, practical actions for the bank. It leads sustainability reporting and engagement with key external stakeholders on sustainability matters, including regulators, investors, industry bodies and ecosystem partners.

We are seeking an **Associate** who can analyse and synthesise complex information, to provide strategic insights and actionable recommendations to inform decisions and delivery of the bank’s strategic sustainability priorities. The role will also involve the coordination and delivery of agreed actions across multiple stakeholders. The role suits a rigorous, adaptable thinker who challenges assumptions, exercises sound judgement. The successful candidate should also demonstrate curiosity, a growth mindset and a willingness to learn across different sustainability workstreams.

  

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

This role offers the opportunity to work across the Chief Sustainability Office’s priorities. The Associate will be expected to:

* **Contribute to strategic priorities** by supporting senior management and key governance forums with concise analyses, recommendations, agendas and papers, and helping to follow agreed actions through to completion.
* **Translate external developments** into practical insights by assessing relevant market, regulatory, technology and industry trends and identifying their implications for DBS.
* **Engage teams across DBS units and markets** to shape the approach, coordinate implementation and support consistent delivery of sustainability priorities.
* **Support internal engagements and capability building across the bank** by developing practical tools, guidance, communications and learning initiatives.
* **Support external engagements** with regulators, industry groups and ecosystem partners by coordinating inputs, preparing relevant materials and ensuring clear follow-through on agreed actions.

  

**First-Year Success Profile**

* Build a strong understanding of DBS’ sustainability priorities, governance and stakeholder landscape.
* Deliver assigned works to agreed scope, milestones and quality standards, with challenges/risks surfaced early.
Earn trust with senior stakeholders through well-supported recommendations, crisp executive materials and reliable follow-through.  

**Differentiated Capabilities**

* Strong interest and working knowledge of key sustainability-related themes and developments (e.g. regulatory, geopolitical, technological), with the judgement to distinguish signal from noise.
* Applies critical thinking to complex or ambiguous issues, developing clear options, well-supported recommendations and practical next steps.
* Engages stakeholders effectively by building constructive working relationships, adapting communication for different audiences.
Takes ownership of assigned work with high attention to detail and adapts constructively while working collaboratively with others.  

**Preferred Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in sustainability/environmental, business, finance or a related field.
* Two or more years of working experience in a relevant field, exposure to financial services is advantageous.
* Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative analysis to develop executive-ready materials with clear insights and recommendations.

**Location:**

DBS Asia Central

**Job:**

Strategic Planning

**Schedule:**

Regular

**Employee Status:**

Full time
